ladder: washing machine > type (Which? tests by drum capacity)
facets: cleaning stars; capacity
quality_markers: overall stain cleaning (40%); rinsing (15%); spin drying (15%); energy and water per kg (10%); programme length (7.5%); ease of use (7.5%); quietness (5%)
quality_signals: Best Buy 75%+; Eco Buy 60%+ with reliability record; Great Value 65%+ and cheaper than average; Don't Buy 45% or below
notes: Independent lab; buys all machines; reliability from member survey feeds Eco Buy.

ladder: Home > Marken > Miele > Wäschepflege > Waschmaschinen
facets: Bauform (front, under-counter, stackable); Füllmenge 7/8/9 kg; energy label; smart home; dosing; programmes
quality_markers: capacity fitted to household; functions matching habits; energy and water efficiency; durability; connectivity
quality_signals: EU energy label A; motor lifespan claim (maker)
notes: Brand page leads with maker then laundry then appliance type; text is maker copy not filter panel.

ladder: vacuum cleaners > cable vs battery
facets: cable; battery; floor models; hand-held
quality_markers: suction 45%; handling 30%; environment 15% (dust retention, noise, power); durability 10%; safety and pollutants 0% but can cap grade
quality_signals: test.de Qualitätsurteil school grades; EN 60312-1 dust pickup; deductions for weak suction or poor durability
notes: Independent German foundation; 141 vacuums tested; cable and battery split.

ladder: Vacuums > Cordless / Corded / Stick / Canister / Upright / Handheld
facets: cordless; pet hair; carpets; car; hardwood; stairs; budget; lightweight
quality_markers: not shown (paywall)
notes: Best-of pages lead with use (pet hair, carpet, hardwood, stairs) and form (stick, upright, canister).

facets: none shown on page
quality_markers: not stated

facets: type; use; wattage; brand
quality_markers: not stated

quality_markers: fit to home and climate; efficiency SEER and HSPF; added features
notes: Utility guide; heat pump is one heating and cooling family split by heat source.

facets: type; EER; SEER; moisture removal
quality_markers: correct sizing; Energy Star listing; moisture removal; support and reputation; ducts

ladder: type > size > cost > review criteria
facets: air source; mini-split; geothermal; hybrid; solar; absorption
quality_markers: performance; temperature range; efficiency; sound; features; reliability; warranty
notes: Advises professional sizing and installation.

ladder: air-to-water heat pumps (mono)
facets: efficiency; output; price; noise
quality_markers: efficiency and climate impact 70%; handling 25%; data protection 5%
notes: Independent test weighs running efficiency most; data protection of the app is scored.

ladder: 14 product categories incl. air source heat pumps, geothermal heat pumps, room air cleaners, room air conditioners, dehumidifiers, ventilating fans
facets: category-specific criteria PDFs
quality_markers: efficiency above certified tier
quality_signals: ENERGY STAR Most Efficient (set by EPA)
notes: US government tier on top of ENERGY STAR; water heaters not on this list.

source_name: Toshiba Lifestyle Japan air conditioner guide

facets: room size; APF; annual kWh; noise dB; self-cleaning; air purification; app

source_name: Fine Homebuilding forum: picking a heat pump

facets: brand; compressor type; efficiency tier
quality_markers: installation quality (vacuum, charge); scroll compressor; efficiency tier suited to climate
notes: Installer and sizing matter more than the brand badge; brand talk anecdotal.

facets: own brand vs third-party brand
quality_markers: range; advice; delivery; dealing with problems; value; durability and quality of fixtures
quality_signals: Which? member survey scores by retailer and fixture
notes: Bathroom fixtures rated by retailer and own brand, not by fixture type; scores paywalled.

ladder: Baumarkt & Garten > Bauen & Renovieren > Sicherheitstechnik > (motion detectors; padlocks; safes; cash boxes; key boxes; sirens; alarm detectors; extinguishers; alarm systems; deadbolts; biometric access; window handles)
facets: Testsieger; Score 70+/80+/90+; price bands; brand; tested by
quality_markers: VdS certification for locks and window locks; mechanical protection before cameras; PIR sensors; Full HD and 10-15 m IR for cameras; local storage; avoid dummy cameras
quality_signals: VdS; Testsieger score tiers (Empfehlenswert, Hervorragend, Außergewöhnlich)
notes: German aggregator mixes security with tools; leads with device type then aggregate test score.

ladder: sensor type (ionisation; photoelectric; dual; CO and heat alarms) > features > certification
facets: non-removable 10-year battery; test button; hush; battery monitor; escape light; interconnection; insect screen
quality_markers: photoelectric best for homes; certification; features listed
notes: Fire authority advice favours photoelectric; CO and heat alarms are add-ons not replacements.

source_name: Liberty Safe (maker blog on UL and ETL ratings)
ladder: what to protect (burglary; paper; digital media) > risk > label > budget
facets: burglary rating; fire class 350/150/125; fire minutes and temperature
quality_markers: third-party label; right fire class; bolting down
quality_signals: UL RSC Level I-III; TL-15; TL-30; TL-30x6; UL Class 350/150/125; ETL Verified
notes: Maker sells safes; ratings are how safes are ranked. Fire safes are not burglary safes.

quality_markers: anti-snap, anti-pick, anti-drill; certification
notes: Leads with certified security level then fit; sizes by measuring existing cylinder.
